method: One representative value per year -- the median of the readings within a plus or minus 7 day window around the same day of the year -- then the median of those across 1991 through 2020, so every year carries the same weight whether its provider reported daily or monthly. Monthly values are the median of each calendar month's mean storage across the same years. Built once and committed, because a normal over a closed period does not change.
